name: Compare Neural Activity Across Epochs

params.name: Cell Set Files (Region 1)
params.description: Cell set files for the first brain region (or the only region in single-brain-region mode).

params.name: Event Set Files (Region 1)
params.description: Event set files for the first brain region (or the only region in single-brain-region mode).

params.name: Brain Region Selection
params.description: Choose single brain region (current workflow) or multiple regions (region 1 and region 2 analyzed separately using the same epoch workflow).

params.name: Cell Set Files (Region 2)
params.description: Cell set files for the second brain region. Required when Brain Region Selection is set to multiple regions.

params.name: Event Set Files (Region 2)
params.description: Optional event set files for the second brain region. If omitted, region 1 event files are reused.

params.name: Brain Region 1 Name
params.description: Display name to label Region 1 rows in output CSVs when Brain Region Selection is set to multiple regions.

params.name: Brain Region 2 Name
params.description: Display name to label Region 2 rows in output CSVs when Brain Region Selection is set to multiple regions.

params.name: Sort Files by Time
params.description: Whether to sort the cell set files by start time. If False, order of input cell sets is maintainted.

params.name: Sampling Rate Tolerance
params.description: Tolerance for potential discrepancies in the sampling rate of input cell sets. If not specified, defaults to 1e-4.

params.name: Define Epochs by
params.description: Method to define epochs. If 'files', one epoch per input cell set will be automatically defined, for the whole duration of each cell set. If 'global file time', you can define as many epochs as you want, with 0 corresponding to start time of the first cell set. If 'local file time', you can define as many epochs as you want per input cell set, with 0 corresponding to start time of each cell set.

params.name: Epochs
params.description: Tuples of the start and end times (in seconds) for each epoch (e.g., if 'Define Epochs by' is set to 'Global file time', `(0, 600), (650, 950), (950, 1250)`). If 'Define Epochs by' is set to 'Local file time', provide one list of tuple per input cell set file (e.g., `[(0, 600)], [(0, 300), (300, 600)]`). If 'Define Epochs by' is set to 'Files', you can leave this parameter empty.

params.name: Epoch Names
params.description: List of names of the epochs to analyze (e.g., `baseline, early treatment, late treatment`)

params.name: Baseline Epoch
params.description: Epoch name to use as baseline for modulation calculations. Must match one of the provided epoch names. If set to Auto or left blank, the first epoch is used.

params.name: Epoch Comparison Method
params.description: How epochs are compared for modulation calculations. Currently only epoch_vs_baseline is supported (future: pairwise).

params.name: Time Bin Size
params.description: If specified, the data will be averaged into bins of this size (in seconds), effectively downsampling the data

params.name: Traces Rescaling Method
params.description: The trace activity data will be rescaled using the specified method. If 'none' is selected, the original raw calcium trace values will be used without any transformation, preserving the original scale of the measurements.

params.name: Event Rates Rescaling Method
params.description: If specified, the event rate data will be rescaled using the specified method

params.name: Significance Level
params.description: Significance level for statistical tests

params.name: Number of Shuffles
params.description: Number of shuffles for permutation tests

params.name: Epoch Colors
params.description: List of matplotlib compatible colors to represent each epoch

params.name: Modulation colormap
params.description: Comma-separated colors used for modulation visualizations in the order (up, down, non). Example: `red, blue, gray`.

results.name: Activity Per Epoch Data
results.description: Calcium activity per cell for each epoch

results.name: Correlations Per Epoch Data
results.description: Correlation statistics per cell for each epoch

results.name: Modulation vs Baseline Data
results.description: Trace and event modulation relative to the baseline epoch

results.name: Average Correlations Summary
results.description: Average positive and negative correlations per epoch

results.name: Pairwise Correlation Heatmaps
results.description: Raw correlation matrices stored in HDF5 format

results.name: Spatial Correlation Archive
results.description: Spatial correlation matrices and cell pairs packaged as ZIP

description: Calculate change in activity during user defined continuous epochs
